scope.purpose: Audit current public gallery visual implementation before locking the permanent design system.

currentColors.finding: The current blue palette does not match Indigo Paper and token names are visual-theme-specific rather than semantic.

currentTypography.finding: Figtree and Fraunces are not configured, and component text sizes are scattered in CSS.

currentSpacing.finding: Spacing works functionally but is not governed by the approved 4px scale.

issues: Hero is a bordered, shadowed, gradient panel.
Hub cards use borders and large shadows.
Image cards use borders and large shadows.
Hero preview tiles reuse image-card styling inside a larger hero card.
Related hubs render as another wall of boxed cards.

currentButtons.finding: Small gallery actions use a separate mini-button style instead of the governed button family.

galleryDensity.issue: The gallery does not render thousands of items at once, but every image tile is presented as a bordered and shadowed card.

mobileRisks: Header stacks into a full-width button area on small screens.
Hero type can dominate mobile viewports.
Repeated card grids make mobile pages feel long and boxed.
requiredRefactors: Split global CSS into token, base, layout, and component layers.
Configure Figtree and Fraunces through next/font/google.
Remove gradients, glass effects, decorative borders, and non-button shadows.
Refactor public pages around editorial sections, stable gallery rhythm, and image-first previews.
Centralize button variants and focus-visible treatment.
Preserve existing data, route, sitemap, asset resolver, local proxy, and no per-image page behavior.
